## 1.0.0 (2026-10-17)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* match PairIP StartupLauncher without exact access flags ([22a988b](https://github.com/fynnaly/morphe-patches/commit/22a988b9fc293c70c3a43af429c3ce4d145a32a3)), closes [#1](https://github.com/fynnaly/morphe-patches/issues/1)
* remove trailing comma breaking patches build script ([354ce29](https://github.com/fynnaly/morphe-patches/commit/354ce2962e8563c3a4046ee27221eb0bd10c0281))
* stop neutralizing VMRunner, it force-closes via Facebook provider ([42a8106](https://github.com/fynnaly/morphe-patches/commit/42a81066b76aec86574f0e39d4bc87fe82bb4129))

### ✨ New Features

* add PairIP bypass for 20 Minutes Till Dawn 8.6 ([4a50bf2](https://github.com/fynnaly/morphe-patches/commit/4a50bf21d879aed19187d991ecb6ddec198751a1))
* bypass PairIP signature, license and VM gate for 20MTD ([fc766ae](https://github.com/fynnaly/morphe-patches/commit/fc766ae4a1660f4e681e47d904a5e74c6a879761))
* fully unlock 20 Minutes Till Dawn runtime (PairIP VM, string pool, ads SDK) ([9dea8ac](https://github.com/fynnaly/morphe-patches/commit/9dea8ac660d1a772448fa8fa8325452b3c535fb2))
* skip rewarded ads to instantly grant unlock rewards ([a70095f](https://github.com/fynnaly/morphe-patches/commit/a70095f52b649bac1f70984c68612ecc21f466b4))

patches.name: Bypass PairIP signature, license & VM gate
patches.description: Neutralises the PairIP signature and license gates, restores the virtualised lifecycle methods with real Unity delegating bodies, and skips the startup VM program. Required for every Minutes Till Dawn patch.

patches.name: Skip rewarded ads
patches.description: Grants the rewarded-ad reward without playing the video, so every "watch an ad to unlock" gate (heroes, guns, coupons, daily gift) resolves instantly.
